name: root-crate-load-ingest-split
body: Wave D of the multi-wave task-19 decomposition (behaviour unchanged). `src/load.rs` is decomposed into `load/{parquet,tables,export}`, with `load/mod.rs` holding the module declarations. `src/ingest.rs` is decomposed into `ingest/{identity,blacklist,render,edges}`. The ingest core stays in `ingest/mod.rs` (`ingest_records`, `claim`, `ingest`, `opt`, `spec_node`, `insert_node`, `finalize_graph`, `IngestOptions`, `Reuse`, `IngestReport`), so its durable spine identities (`rust.apg.ingest.ingest_records`, `rust.apg.ingest.claim`) keep resolving, and the module FQNs `rust.apg.ingest` and `rust.apg.load` stay via `mod.rs`. The 5 `implemented-by` edges for functions that move target the post-split FQNs; the module-level edges and the two edges targeting core units stay.
